_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from original Spanish Peruvian Fiscalía and judiciary reports. Five legally separate drug-case networks are modeled. Each person is individually named with a reported conviction; publication dates are used where the judgment day is not stated. No precise or live positions, operational routes, enforcement gaps, or unlicensed portraits are included. Co-mentions are not treated as person relationships.
